title: SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.18025v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time scaling has enabled LLMs to solve increasingly complex reasoning, discovery, and optimization tasks. However, existing approaches often gather observations while seeking evidence for current hypotheses, then generate new hypotheses conditioned on those hypotheses and their associated evidence. This couples observation discovery to existing hypotheses, favoring local refinements over exploration of unknown hypotheses regions. Inspired by the hypothetico-deductive method (Hempel, 1945) and dual-space models of scientific discovery (Klahr & Dunbar, 1988), we introduce SHELDON, a scientific reasoning harness that separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces. By actively seeking new observations along with new hypotheses, SHELDON can discover observations that its current hypotheses do not explain. These unexplained observations expose gaps in its understanding, motivate new investigations, and guide

translated_title: SHELDON：通过假设空间与观测空间的双重搜索进行推理
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展已使大语言模型能够解决日益复杂的推理、发现和优化任务。然而，现有方法通常在为当前假设寻找证据的同时收集观测数据，随后基于这些假设及其相关证据来生成新假设。这种做法将观测数据的发现与现有假设耦合在一起，导致模型偏向局部改进，而非探索未知的假设区域。受假设-演绎方法（Hempel, 1945）和科学发现的双空间模型（Klahr & Dunbar, 1988）的启发，我们提出了 SHELDON——一个分别表示并联合探索假设空间与观测空间的科学推理框架。通过在生成新假设的同时主动寻求新的观测数据，SHELDON 能够发现其当前假设无法解释的观测。这些无法解释的观测暴露了模型理解中的空白，激发新的探究方向，并引导……
tldr: 提出 SHELDON 科学推理框架，通过对假设空间和观测空间的双重搜索进行联合探索，使其能发现当前假设无法解释的观测，从而暴露理解空白并驱动新的科学探究。
en_tdlr: SHELDON is a scientific reasoning harness that separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces, enabling it to discover observations unexplained by current hypotheses, thereby exposing gaps in understanding and motivating new investigations.
